title: He Hideth My Soul
alsoKnownAs: A Wonderful Saviour Is Jesus My Lord
description: He Hideth My Soul in Tonic Solfa to KIRKPATRICK: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the four verses and the refrain, and a piano.
about: Fanny Crosby wrote the words, published in 1890 with the tune KIRKPATRICK by William J. Kirkpatrick.
underlay: A won-der-ful Sa-viour is Je-sus my Lord, A won-der-ful Sa-viour to me; He hid-eth my soul in the cleft of the rock, Where riv-ers of plea-sure I see. He hid-eth my soul in the cleft of the rock, That sha-dows a dry, thirst-y land; He hid-eth my life in the depths of His love, And cov-ers me there with His hand, And cov-ers me there with_ His hand.

lines: A wonderful Saviour is Jesus my Lord,
A wonderful Saviour to me;
He hideth my soul in the cleft of the rock,
Where rivers of pleasure I see.

verses.label: Refrain
lines: He hideth my soul in the cleft of the rock,
That shadows a dry, thirsty land;
He hideth my life in the depths of His love,
And covers me there with His hand,
And covers me there with His hand.
A wonderful Saviour is Jesus my Lord,
He taketh my burden away,
He holdeth me up and I shall not be moved,
He giveth me strength as my day.
With numberless blessings each moment He crowns,
And filled with His fullness divine,
I sing in my rapture, oh, glory to God!
For such a Redeemer as mine.
When clothed with His brightness transported I rise
To meet Him in clouds of the sky,
His perfect salvation, His wonderful love,
I’ll shout with the millions on high.
